verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party feature for exporting all of a user's data in open formats. The public API spec, the CLI's log streaming, and self-hosting are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented full-data export. The GlitchTip migration story describes repointing new events by changing the DSN, not exporting existing data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
